design_changes: Main canyon/escarpment/spire controls unchanged; corner fillets move only intervening geometry by at most 12m.
scar_trail endpoint moved from (-350,-330)m to (-350,-270)m, 60m north, to meet the switchback rim instead of dropping straight to the canyon floor at an impossible trail grade.
shelf_trail endpoint moved from (480,470)m to (440,435)m, 53.15m southwest, to meet the notch foot instead of ending halfway up its wall.
Explicit descent traverses extend along walls around the requested anchors; two additional Scar end escapes serve isolated ends.
Descent hairpins have explicit 15m-radius arc controls so the walkable corridor does not fold across a sharp polyline reversal.

Round3: scar_trail approach (-2500,2500) -> (-6000,-2300)cm; shelf_trail approach (13000,8500) -> (9000,12800)cm. Depart outside protected home/wreck cores whose uneditable baseline cross slope already exceeds .02; landmarks and original route geometry stay fixed.

Round3: west escape anchors (-85000,-18000)/(-85000,-31300) -> (-83000,-23500)/(-80000,-32667)cm; east (29000,-65000)/(29000,-73800) -> (31700,-65864)/(27000,-72364)cm. Floors moved off the canyon end caps onto the deep centreline; top anchors outside the rim. Native generator supplies sufficient run.

Round3: scar_gully/scar_scramble retain their top and bottom anchors; replace explicit tight-bend controls with native generated hairpins. Scramble traverse_direction=-1 selects the westward leg, away from the east escape.
fall_cache_risks: West_drop has no ascent: a surviving fall may leave cache inaccessible from above.
Scar/Shelf ledges away from descents can strand surviving-fall caches; fatal falls retain existing last-safe-rim relocation.
Canyon end caps near world boundary require traversal review.
